name: fable-ous
description: Minimal native Codex presentation with work controls left to the host.

interface.shortDescription: Outcome-first Codex replies that preserve proof and caveats.
interface.longDescription: Run `fable-ous install` once to apply a minimal reversible Codex presentation preset. It prioritizes the outcome, enough evidence, material caveats, and the next action while leaving work, safety, verification, and completion to Codex.
defaultPrompt: Lead with the outcome in warm, plain language.
Preserve enough evidence, material caveats or missing proof, and the next action; omit secondary detail and repetition.
